#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import sys
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

API_BASE = "https://agenskill-api.onrender.com"

with open("email_credentials.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    creds = json.load(f)

API_KEY = creds["account"]["api_key"]
USER_EMAIL = creds["account"]["email"]

req = urllib.request.Request(
    API_BASE + "/contacts",
    headers={
        "X-API-Key": API_KEY,
        "X-User-Email": USER_EMAIL,
        "Accept": "application/json",
    },
    method="GET",
)

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        print(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("HTTPError: %s %s" % (e.code, e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print("Error: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
